title: Questão 92 - ENEM 2014 - Terceira aplicação
context:
Slow Food

Slow Food describes a movement created “to
counteract fast food and fast life, the disappearance
of local food traditions and people’s dwindling interest
in the food they eat, where it comes from, how it tastes
and how our food choices affect the rest of the world,”
according to the movement’s website. More broadly,
it involves an emphasis on local and seasonal produce
and an adherence to regional cultures. Its goals also
include lobbying against the use of pesticides and genetic
engineering of food.

Disponível em: www.ecomii.com. Acesso em: 30 set. 2011.
